User interface (UI) design is critical for a successful and easy-to-use application. To achieve this goal, the development team should adopt the so-called user-centered design and follow the general user experience and user interface design heuristics.

(a) What is user-centered design? What are the principles for a user-centered design process? (10%)

(b) List and explain at least four well-known user experience and user interface design heuristics. (15%)
